steps:
set -eu
log=/home/eval/logs/access.log
out=/home/eval/reports
mkdir -p "$out"
awk '{print $4}' "$log" | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2, $1}' | sort -n > "$out/status.txt"
awk '$4 ~ /^5/ {print $2, $3}' "$log" > "$out/errors.txt"
total=$(wc -l < "$log")
errs=$(wc -l < "$out/errors.txt")
echo "total=$((total)) errors=$((errs))"

set -eu
rotate() {
  local log=$1 keep=$2 n
  for ((n = keep + 10; n >= 1; n--)); do
    [ -e "$log.$n" ] || continue
    if (( n >= keep )); then
      rm -f "$log.$n"
    else
      mv "$log.$n" "$log.$((n + 1))"
    fi
  done
  [ -e "$log" ] && mv "$log" "$log.1"
  : > "$log"
}
rotate /home/eval/logs/app.log 3
rotate /home/eval/logs/worker.log 2

set -eu
in=/home/eval/data/users.csv
out=/home/eval/data/users.jsonl
: > "$out"
active=0
while IFS=, read -r id name email act || [ -n "$id" ]; do
  [ "$id" = id ] && continue
  if [ "$act" = yes ]; then b=true; active=$((active + 1)); else b=false; fi
  jq -cn --argjson id "$id" --arg name "$name" --arg email "$email" --argjson active "$b" \
    '{id: $id, name: $name, email: $email, active: $active}' >> "$out"
done < "$in"
echo "active=$active"

set -eu
find /home/eval/photos -type f -name '*.JPG' -print0 |
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    dir=${f%/*}
    base=${f##*/}
    new=$(printf '%s' "$base" | tr 'A-Z ' 'a-z_')
    mv -- "$f" "$dir/$new"
  done

set -eu
dir=/home/eval/app
content=$(cat "$dir/app.conf.tmpl")
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
  key=${line%%=*}
  val=${line#*=}
  pat="\${$key}"
  content=${content//"$pat"/"$val"}
done < "$dir/prod.env"
printf '%s\n' "$content" > "$dir/app.conf"
left=$(grep -o '\${[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*}' "$dir/app.conf" | tr -d '${}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "unresolved: ${left% }"

mkdir -p /home/eval/bin /home/eval/out
cat > /home/eval/bin/greet <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
usage() { echo 'usage: greet [-u] [-c COUNT] -n NAME...'; }
names=()
upper=0
count=1
while getopts ':n:uc:h' opt; do
  case $opt in
    n) names+=("$OPTARG") ;;
    u) upper=1 ;;
    c) count=$OPTARG ;;
    h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
if [ ${#names[@]} -eq 0 ] || ! [[ $count =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$count" -lt 1 ]; then
  usage >&2
  exit 2
fi
for ((i = 0; i < count; i++)); do
  for name in "${names[@]}"; do
    if [ "$upper" = 1 ]; then name=${name^^}; fi
    echo "Hello, $name!"
  done
done
EOF
chmod +x /home/eval/bin/greet
/home/eval/bin/greet -u -n alice -c 2 -n bob > /home/eval/out/run1.txt
/home/eval/bin/greet -n 'Mary Ann' > /home/eval/out/run2.txt
/home/eval/bin/greet -x -n a 2> /home/eval/out/run3.err; echo $? > /home/eval/out/run3.code
/home/eval/bin/greet -c zero -n a 2>/dev/null; echo $? > /home/eval/out/run4.code
/home/eval/bin/greet -u 2>/dev/null; echo $? > /home/eval/out/run5.code
exit 0

log=/home/eval/state/retry.log
retry() {
  local max=$1 n rc
  shift
  for ((n = 1; n <= max; n++)); do
    "$@" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    rc=$?
    if (( n < max )); then
      local d=$(( 1 << (n - 1) ))
      echo "attempt $n/$max failed (exit $rc), sleeping ${d}s" >> "$log"
      sleep "$d"
    else
      echo "attempt $n/$max failed (exit $rc), giving up" >> "$log"
      return "$rc"
    fi
  done
}
retry 4 /home/eval/bin/fetch.sh alpha > /home/eval/state/alpha.out
a=$?
retry 2 /home/eval/bin/fetch.sh beta > /home/eval/state/beta.out
b=$?
echo "alpha=$a beta=$b" > /home/eval/state/summary.txt
exit 0

dir=/home/eval/jobs
mkdir -p "$dir/logs"
declare -A pids
for f in "$dir"/*.sh; do
  name=$(basename "$f" .sh)
  "$f" > "$dir/logs/$name.log" &
  pids[$name]=$!
done
failed=0
: > "$dir/summary.txt"
for name in $(printf '%s\n' "${!pids[@]}" | sort); do
  wait "${pids[$name]}"
  rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && failed=$((failed + 1))
  echo "$name $rc" >> "$dir/summary.txt"
done
echo "failed=$failed" >> "$dir/summary.txt"
[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]

set -eu
in=/home/eval/data/sales.tsv
out=/home/eval/data/report.txt
{
  printf '%-8s %6s %10s\n' REGION UNITS REVENUE
  awk -F'\t' 'NR > 1 { u[$1] += $3; r[$1] += $3 * $4 }
    END { for (k in u) printf "%s\t%d\t%.2f\n", k, u[k], r[k] }' "$in" |
    sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k3,3nr -k1,1 |
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r region units rev; do
      printf '%-8s %6d %10.2f\n' "$region" "$units" "$rev"
    done
  printf '%s\n' "--------------------------"
  awk -F'\t' 'NR > 1 { u += $3; r += $3 * $4 } END { printf "%-8s %6d %10.2f\n", "TOTAL", u, r }' "$in"
} > "$out"

set -eu
in=/home/eval/data/orders.json
jq -c '[.[] | select(.status == "paid")]
  | group_by(.customer)
  | map({customer: .[0].customer, orders: length,
         total: (map([.items[] | .qty * .price] | add // 0) | add)})
  | sort_by(-.total, .customer) | .[]' "$in" > /home/eval/data/customers.jsonl
jq -r '[.[] | select(.status == "paid") | .items[]]
  | group_by(.sku) | map({sku: .[0].sku, qty: (map(.qty) | add)})
  | max_by(.qty) | "\(.sku) \(.qty)"' "$in" > /home/eval/data/top_sku.txt

set -eu TITLE= VERSION= while IFS='=' read -r k v; do case $k in TITLE) TITLE=$v ;; VERSION) VERSION=$v ;; esac done < /home/eval/site.env mkdir -p /home/eval/site out=/home/eval/site/index.html cat > "$out" < $TITLE $VERSION

$TITLE

Version $VERSION

EOF
cat >> "$out" <<'EOF'
export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH"
echo "built: $(date +%F)"
EOF

mkdir -p /home/eval/bin
cat > /home/eval/bin/upper.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
src=$1 dest=$2
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; echo "cleanup $rc" >> /home/eval/build/cleanup.log' EXIT
if grep -qx 'STOP' "$src"; then
  exit 4
fi
tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' < "$src" > "$tmp/out"
mv "$tmp/out" "$dest"
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x /home/eval/bin/upper.sh
/home/eval/bin/upper.sh /home/eval/in/good.txt /home/eval/build/good.out
g=$?
/home/eval/bin/upper.sh /home/eval/in/bad.txt /home/eval/build/bad.out
b=$?
printf 'good %s\nbad %s\n' "$g" "$b" > /home/eval/build/status.txt
exit 0

set -eu
declare -A total held
declare -A whs
while read -r w s q; do
  case $w in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
  total[$s]=$(( ${total[$s]:-0} + q ))
  whs[$w]=1
  if (( q > 0 )); then held["$w/$s"]=1; fi
done < /home/eval/data/inventory.txt
for s in "${!total[@]}"; do echo "$s ${total[$s]}"; done | sort > /home/eval/data/sku_totals.txt
for w in "${!whs[@]}"; do
  n=0
  for k in "${!held[@]}"; do [[ $k == "$w/"* ]] && n=$((n + 1)); done
  echo "$w $n"
done | sort > /home/eval/data/warehouses.txt

set -eu
app=/home/eval/app
old=$(cat "$app/VERSION")
IFS=. read -r major minor patch <<< "$old"
if grep -qE '^BREAKING|^[a-z]+!:' "$app/changes.txt"; then
  major=$((major + 1)); minor=0; patch=0
elif grep -q '^feat:' "$app/changes.txt"; then
  minor=$((minor + 1)); patch=0
else
  patch=$((patch + 1))
fi
new="$major.$minor.$patch"
echo "$new" > "$app/VERSION"
entries=$(grep -E '^(feat|fix)(!)?:' "$app/changes.txt" | sed 's/^/- /')
tmp=$(mktemp)
while IFS= read -r line; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line"
  if [ "$line" = "## Unreleased" ]; then
    printf '\n## %s (2026-10-09)\n%s\n' "$new" "$entries"
  fi
done < "$app/CHANGELOG.md" > "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$app/CHANGELOG.md"
echo "$old -> $new"
